Name: Task 1 - Book CRUD
Description: Book model, migration, CRUD endpoints and inventory/fee validation. Branch codex/01-books-crud.

Name: Task 2 - Book permissions
Description: Public reads and staff-only writes. Depends on task 1. Branch codex/02-book-permissions.

Name: Task 3 - User accounts
Description: Email registration, custom Authorize JWT header and own-profile updates. Branch codex/03-user-accounts.

Name: Task 4 - Borrowing list and detail
Description: Dated borrowing records and nested book information. Depends on tasks 1 and 3. Branch codex/04-borrowing-list-detail.

Name: Task 5 - Create borrowing
Description: Atomic stock decrement, current-user ownership and out-of-stock handling. Depends on task 4. Branch codex/05-create-borrowing.

Name: Task 6 - Borrowing filters
Description: Active/returned and staff user filtering with owner isolation. Depends on task 4. Branch codex/06-borrowing-filters.

Name: Task 7 - Return borrowing
Description: One-time return, stock restoration and five-user PostgreSQL contention tests. Depends on tasks 5 and 6. Branch codex/07-return-borrowing.
